summary.name: Statsnet
summary.one_liner: Statsnet is a company search and business verification service for checking registration, management, courts and risk factors of companies worldwide.
use_cases: Carry out due diligence on a company
Look up official company registry extracts
summary.what_it_does: Statsnet lets users search for companies and verify their business details. It screens companies against 37 risk factors using what it describes as unique analytical indicators. It provides extracts from state registers, courts and law enforcement agencies. It also shows ownership and management structure, including foreign beneficial owners. The page offers quick filters for searching.
notable: Includes extracts from state registers, courts and law enforcement agencies
Shows foreign beneficial owners and management structure
caveats: Pricing tiers and full feature limits are not described on the page
Coverage depends on available state register data by country
